name: Prompt Bar
summary: An AI chat input. The classic bar has a level selector, sparks at the top level, a morphing send button, rotating placeholders, and optional sources, commands, models and dictation. The expanding pill rests as a mic pill and opens into a card with suggestions, a model picker and an effort chip.
useWhen: An AI chat or agent needs its main input
Users choose how much effort or depth the AI should use
A compact voice-first input should grow into a full composer on focus
avoidWhen: A plain search box or short form field is enough
The app needs rich text editing
